title: D1_1
characteristics: tissue: blood; condition: subacute ischemic stroke

data_processing: Reads filtering under criteria removing reads with 20% of the base quality lower than 13; HISAT2.1.0 mapping to reference genome; count counting; Genome_build: GRCh38; Supplementary_files_format_and_content: TXT file contain counts for each sample
